name: openbb_commodity_lbma_gold
description:
Meant to give gold prices through OpenBB; despite the name it requests the GC=F futures series from obb.commodity.price.historical, not the LBMA fixing.
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): provider (schema default fmp; when omitted the tool sends yfinance); symbol (accepted by the schema, but passing it collides with the fixed symbol and fails).
OpenBB 4.x (4.6 checked) has no obb.commodity.price.historical, so this tool currently returns an error object; alternatives: fred_gold_price, or openbb_derivatives_futures_historical with symbol GC=F.
Example: {"provider": "yfinance"}
